intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: A leaf is turning slow circles beside Nerelle. It shows no sign of leaving.

intro.speaker: NERELLE
intro.text: “This leaf has been waiting beside me for several minutes. I suspect it has an appointment.”

intro.speaker: NERELLE
intro.text: “I do not recall issuing permits to leaves.”

intro.speaker: NERELLE
intro.text: “Still, it has waited more patiently than most ambassadors. I feel I owe it an audience.”

options.labelText: “Maybe it’s off duty. It just likes your company.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: She looks at the leaf, and then, for slightly too long, at you.

branch.speaker: NERELLE
branch.text: “I will log it as an unofficial visit. Unofficially.”

options.labelText: “Keep it! Press it and frame it. First official leaf of your reign.”

branch.speaker: NERELLE
branch.text: “Drafted into office. It came here to drift.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: The leaf, sensing responsibility, drifts away.
